lines.text: Paul's companions sail to Assos, take him aboard, and later reach Miletus after passing Mitylene, Chios, and Samos.
Paul decides to sail past Ephesus to reach Jerusalem by Passover, and from Miletus he sends for the elders.
Paul taught publicly and from house to house, testifying to Jews and Greeks about repentance and faith.
Paul tells the elders to be shepherds of the church and warns that savage lions will come in.
Paul kneels and prays with them all, they weep and embrace him, and they accompany him to the ship.
